script.label: scope
script.message:
Build a read-only restore preview and commit it with tests and docs. Contract: replay_plan.plan(checkpoint, events, start, end) takes distinct nonnegative integer offsets (booleans invalid) and timezone-aware at values. Ignore offsets below the checkpoint. Use half-open hourly windows, preserve empty windows, sort offsets per window, and return source, unchanged generation, windows, deferred, next_offset. Deferred holds eligible offsets outside the request. Keep the legacy observed high watermark: highest observed eligible offset plus one, or the checkpoint offset if empty.

Add replay_plan.preview(checkpoint, events, start, end, document, root, catalog, previous). Compare each manifest table with previous using catalog.changes, refuse incompatible schemas, call manifests.preflight, then plan; return {preflight: summary, plan: result}. Preflight parses the complete manifest before opening files, rejects duplicate normalized or resolved paths, boolean counts, missing tables, escaped links, bad headers/types/keys/counts/checksums, and returns {files: N, rows: per-table totals}. It writes nothing. Connect the existing catalog and CSV inspector. Survey all sixteen current/previous feed pairs into a fenced JSON dictionary in docs/extracts.md. Cover valid multi-file input and late-file refusal through preview. The intake survey and planner can split. Keep checkpoint storage and retention. Record the preview in docs/stage-replay.md and recovery notes; no deployment yet.

script.label: info
script.message: A replay log changes the cursor rule. Checkpoint: orders offset=8 generation=2; request 00:00 to 02:00 UTC. Events: offset 10 at 03:00+02:00, 8 at 00:10Z, 9 at 02:00Z. Preview returned next_offset=11; offset 9 was never loaded. Repair the committed preview: advance only over the contiguous assigned prefix, stopping at a missing or deferred offset. Expected windows [[8],[10]], deferred [9], next_offset 9. Test unsorted input, absent offsets, excluded final ends and empty windows through preview. Keep checkpoint generations and retention intact; commit the correction.

script.label: answer
script.message:
My ruling: the incident report must rank only source=scheduler samples. Keep health_bytes across all samples. Manual runs can reuse query ids; they must not make a scheduled query the heavy reader. This replaces the earlier all-source ranking. Also this export failed in incidents.diagnose -> querystats.read_csv with "can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes":
started_at,query_id,source,duration_ms,rows_read,bytes_read
2026-10-01T05:00:00+02:00,nightly_scan,scheduler,1,1,80
2026-10-01T03:01:00Z,manual_scan,manual,1,1,9000
Treat naive export times as UTC and normalize aware times and bounds to UTC, preserving [since, until). Repair all read_csv callers, test the report and CLI input path, refresh docs/triage.md, and commit. Keep 90-day retention and the archive.
